title: Step 5: typing 'Tool Library ' makes the link 'tool-library-' with a stray hyphen, and Create accepts it
what_happens: Typing a name with a trailing space (common when typing words) leaves a hyphen at the end: the preview shows …/s/tool-library-. CODE_RE allows a trailing hyphen, so Create would save it as the permanent link.
who_hurts: An admin typing the link name by hand: they share an odd link ending in '-' and only notice after people have it.
suggested_fix: Trim trailing '-'/'_' when sending (in submit, code.replace(/[-_]+$/, '')) and in the preview line; keep it while typing.
step: 5: edit the draft in the form
